title: OutlookSearchEmailsV1Result
description: Locally matched emails for a query, with an optional locally generated summary. Search and summarization both run entirely on the device.

totalMatched.description: Number of matching messages before the limit was applied.

summary.description: Plain-text summary of the hits generated by a local model. Absent when summarization was not requested or no local model is available.

summaryModel.description: Identifier of the local model that generated the summary, for user-facing transparency.

expandedKeywords.description: Search terms actually used after local query expansion.

warnings.description: Local sources or messages that could not be inspected without hiding successful results.

trace.description: Metadata about the sidecar's internal on-device steps (durations, models, item counts). Never contains message content.
